chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
No wealth is lost on land or sea except due to the neglect of zakat, and no bird is caught except that it neglected its glorification.
ai.seo_question: How does neglecting zakat affect wealth according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that loss of wealth is connected to neglecting zakat, showing the grave spiritual and material consequence of withholding obligatory charity. It also states that a bird is only caught when it has neglected its tasbih, emphasizing the significance of dhikr and obedience within creation.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1595 - He (Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as)) said:
"No wealth is lost on land or sea except due to the neglect of Zakat, and no bird is caught except that it neglected its glorification (of Allah (swt))."
